_doc: Shared transform spec (filter/computed/columns/rename) applied identically by the Go sink (CDC path) and the Python bulk loader (initial-load path). Processing order per row: filter (on original fields) -> computed -> column selection (whitelist) -> rename. Key is always <table>:<source-pk>. NOTE: denormalization is NOT part of this shared spec - it is a CDC/sink feature expressed in the per-table YAML under ../transforms/ (see customer_kyc.yaml). Use this file with the bulk loader: TRANSFORMS_FILE=setup/transforms.json.

products._doc: Filter (cache only active products) + computed (price in cents).

users._doc: Column selection: cache identity fields only.

customer_kyc._doc: Column selection. Merging txn aggregates into this key is the denormalize rule in ../transforms/customer_kyc.yaml, applied on the CDC path (not in this shared spec).
